source.text: Have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of a locally advanced recurrent or metastatic solid tumor type of interest with MTAP deletion (for dose escalation: mesothelioma \[pleural or peritoneal\], gastroesophageal cancers \[squamous and adenocarcinoma of esophagus, gastric adenocarcinoma, gastroesophageal junction cancers\], pancreatic adenocarcinoma and biliary tract carcinomas (intrahepatic and extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, and gallbladder cancer), NSCLC \[adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and adeno-squamous\] or UC \[including mixed urothelial-squamous histology\]; for dose expansion: NSCLC that has progressed on at least one prior line of treatment and for which additional effective standard therapy is not available or for which the participant is not a candidate due to intolerance).
Have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of a locally advanced recurrent or metastatic solid tumor type of interest with MTAP deletion
Have at least 1 measurable lesion according to RECIST version 1.1
Have Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status (PS) score of 0 or 1
Known symptomatic brain metastases requiring supraphysiologic doses of systemic corticosteroids
Have had other malignancies within 2 years prior to the first dose, with some exceptions
Have a history of immunodeficiency, with a positive human immunodeficiency virus(HIV) test at screening
Known or suspected viral hepatitis with a positive test at screening
Treatment with no more than 3 prior lines in the setting of advanced or metastatic disease.
